content_sections.heading: About IIT (ISM) Dhanbad
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad, was formerly called the Indian School of Mines and was established in 1926. It is located in Dhanbad – 826 004, Jharkhand. It has 17 full-fledged departments that offer undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral courses in Engineering, Pure and Applied Sciences, Management, and Humanities and Social Sciences.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Deputy Registrar Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The EWS vacancy was first advertised under Advt. No. 411002/12/2025-NFR dated 20.02.2026 and was not filled. The notice says that if no suitable EWS candidate is available, the vacancy may be filled as an unreserved post. The notice says the post is suitable for Divyang candidates with these benchmark disabilities: Low Vision, Hard of Hearing, and Locomotor disability (including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy). content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Deputy Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age, educational qualification and experience are counted as on the closing date for applications. Essential qualification: Masters' degree or equivalent in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade of B in the UGC seven points scale. Essential experience (either of the following): At least 9 years' experience as Assistant Professor in the AGP of Rs. 6000/- (Academic Pay Level – 10) and above, with experience in educational administration, or comparable experience in a research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education; or 5 years' administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or an equivalent post in Pay Band – 3, Grade Pay of Rs. 5400 (Pay Level–10) and above, with experience in handling computerized administration, Establishment, Stores & Purchase or financial matters. Desirable: A degree in Law, Management, Engineering, CA, CS or ICWA from a recognized University or institute. Officers of the Central or State Governments, Institutes of national importance, Universities or University-level institutions, or PSUs who: (a) (i) hold an analogous post, or (ii) have at least 5 years' service in posts carrying Grade Pay of Rs. 6600/- (Pay Level – 11) or its equivalent, with experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters; and (b) hold a Masters' degree or equivalent in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade of B in the UGC seven points scale. The deputation post is held on lien by its regular incumbent. Because of this, only employees of Government organisations, Central Autonomous Bodies or PSUs who are allowed to keep a lien at their parent organisation will be considered. They must submit a supporting document from their parent organisation. Employees of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad who have served at least three years on a regular post: maximum age limit of 50 years. Candidates who have served at least three years on a regular post in the Institute or in other IITs, NITs, CFTIs and similar institutions: the maximum age limit may be relaxed by 5 years. This relaxation is not available to employees of private organisations. Regular employees of Central or State Governments, Ex-Servicemen, Divyang candidates and others: relaxation as per GoI norms. Scrutiny committee decides whether a candidate's experience is relevant to the post, and its decision is final. Candidates without the essential qualifications and experience will be disqualified. For full eligibility details for each mode of recruitment, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Preliminary shortlisting based on the essential qualifications and experience. If a large number of applications is received, the Institute may decide its own method of shortlisting. Presentation and Interview before the Selection Committee. The final selection depends on performance at this stage. The Institute may hold it online. A Written Test and a Computer or other Test may be held, if required, under the Recruitment Rules of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Shortlisted candidates who attend the Presentation and Interview are paid to-and-fro rail fare. This covers the shortest route from their normal place of residence in India to Dhanbad, limited to AC-3 tier, and is paid on submitting a claim with the tickets. Meeting the qualifications does not by itself guarantee a call for the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Deputation period: up to 22.11.2028 at most, or until the regular incumbent returns from deputation, or until further orders, whichever is earlier. If the lien holder rejoins IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, the selected candidate goes back to the parent office or previous post. Other deputation terms follow Institute rules. Posting: the Institute may assign or transfer the selected candidate to any section or department within the Institute. Disclosure: candidates must give full details of past employment, including any disciplinary proceedings, charge sheets or vigilance matters. Hiding such information, whether found before or after appointment, can lead to action under the rules.

faq.question: Q1. Can a general category candidate apply for the direct recruitment vacancy marked EWS?
faq.answer: Yes. If no suitable EWS candidate is available, the vacancy may be filled as an unreserved post, and the notice encourages UR-eligible candidates to apply.

faq.question: Q2. What marks do I need in my Master's degree?
faq.answer: At least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade of B in the UGC seven points scale. The degree can be in any discipline.

faq.question: Q3. Is teaching experience accepted for direct recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. You need at least 9 years as Assistant Professor in the AGP of Rs. 6000/- (Academic Pay Level 10) or above, together with experience in educational administration.

faq.question: Q4. Who does not have to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PwD, Ex-Servicemen and female candidates. All other applicants pay Rs. 1000/- online, and the fee is not refunded.

faq.question: Q5. Do employees of other IITs or NITs get age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with at least three years of regular service in the Institute or in other IITs, NITs or CFTIs may get the age limit relaxed by 5 years. This does not apply to private-sector employees.

faq.question: Q6. How long does the deputation last?
faq.answer: Up to 22.11.2028 at most, or until the regular incumbent returns, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. What must be written on the deputation application envelope?
faq.answer: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DEPUTY REGISTRAR ON DEPUTATION BASIS", in capital letters at the top.

faq.question: Q8. Is travel fare paid for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Shortlisted candidates get to-and-fro rail fare by the shortest route to Dhanbad, limited to AC-3 tier, if they submit a claim with their tickets.

faq.question: Q9. Which date should my EWS certificate carry?
faq.answer: It must be issued on or after 01.04.2026, in the latest Government of India format.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply without my employer's NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Your application is treated as an advance copy, but you must submit the NOC at the interview, or your candidature may not be considered.
